name: Attended In-Lab Polysomnography
sourceName: Synthetic criteria modeled on MCG outpatient guidance. Not licensed MCG content.

versions.approvalRule: All 6 criteria must be met to be approval-ready. Anything else goes to a clinician.
versions.note: If the in-lab criteria are not met, a home sleep apnea test (HSAT) is usually the appropriate first test.

criteria.title: Clinical symptoms of obstructive sleep apnea
criteria.description: At least 2 of the following 3 symptoms are documented: habitual snoring, witnessed apneas, excessive daytime sleepiness.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Provider documentation of each symptom present.

criteria.title: STOP-BANG score of 3 or higher
criteria.description: A STOP-BANG screening score of 3 or more out of 8 is documented.

criteria.title: Standardized daytime sleepiness measure documented
criteria.description: An Epworth Sleepiness Scale (or equivalent) score is recorded.
criteria.evidenceRequired: An ESS score or equivalent instrument result.

criteria.title: Comorbidity that warrants an attended in-lab study
criteria.description: Treatment-resistant hypertension (uncontrolled on 3 or more antihypertensives), congestive heart failure, coronary artery disease, prior stroke, or neuromuscular disease.

criteria.title: Elevated BMI or anatomic airway risk
criteria.description: BMI of 30 or higher, OR Mallampati class III or IV, OR neck circumference over 17 in.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Documented BMI, Mallampati class, or neck circumference.

criteria.title: Non-pharmacologic counseling documented
criteria.description: The provider documented counseling on non-drug interventions such as sleep hygiene, weight management, or positional therapy, and the patient participated.
criteria.evidenceRequired: A note that counseling was given.

versions.approvalRule: All 6 criteria must be met to be approval-ready. Anything else goes to a clinician.
versions.note: If the in-lab criteria are not met, a home sleep apnea test (HSAT) is usually the appropriate first test.

criteria.title: Clinical symptoms of obstructive sleep apnea
criteria.description: At least 2 of the following 3 symptoms are documented: habitual snoring, witnessed apneas (pauses in breathing observed by a bed partner or other person), excessive daytime sleepiness.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Provider documentation of each symptom present. Count how many of the three are explicitly documented.

criteria.title: STOP-BANG score of 3 or higher
criteria.description: A STOP-BANG screening score of 3 or more out of 8 is documented, indicating intermediate to high risk for OSA.
criteria.evidenceRequired: A recorded STOP-BANG score, or enough documented components to determine it.

criteria.title: Standardized daytime sleepiness measure documented
criteria.description: A standardized sleepiness assessment (Epworth Sleepiness Scale or equivalent) has been administered and the score is recorded. Any score satisfies this criterion; the score itself is used for clinical context.
criteria.evidenceRequired: An Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS) score or equivalent instrument result.

criteria.title: Comorbidity that warrants an attended in-lab study
criteria.description: At least one condition that makes an unattended home test inappropriate: treatment-resistant hypertension (uncontrolled on 3 or more antihypertensive medications), congestive heart failure, coronary artery disease, prior stroke, or neuromuscular disease.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Diagnosis of a qualifying condition. For hypertension, the medication list must show 3 or more antihypertensives with BP above goal.

criteria.title: Elevated BMI or anatomic airway risk
criteria.description: BMI of 30 or higher, OR Mallampati class III or IV, OR large neck circumference (over 17 in / 43 cm for men, over 16 in / 40.5 cm for women).
criteria.evidenceRequired: Documented BMI, Mallampati class, or neck circumference.

criteria.title: Non-pharmacologic counseling documented
criteria.description: The provider documented counseling on non-drug interventions such as sleep hygiene, weight management, or positional therapy. Counseling counts even if the patient declined the intervention.
criteria.evidenceRequired: A note that counseling was given, and the patient's response.

changeLog.author: A. Chen, RN, Clinical Policy
changeLog.summary: C5: added a separate neck circumference threshold for women (over 16 in). C6: counseling now counts even if the patient declines. C1: defined witnessed apneas.
